sources.title: phi-3-mini-4k-instruct: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct is a 3.8 billion parameter language model built by microsoft that generates text responses to instructions and questions. The model uses a dense decoder-only Transformer architecture trained on 3.3 trillion tokens combining synthetic data and filtered public websites, with emphasis on high-quality, reasoning-dense properties. It underwent supervised fine-tuning ...

sources.title: phi-3-mini-4k-instruct: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: The Microsoft-published Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct on Hugging Face is the same base model. The lucataco Replicate version provides managed hosting, automatic scaling, and pay-per-inference pricing; the Hugging Face version requires self-hosting but gives full control over quantization, batching, and deployment infrastructure.

sources.title: Phi-3 Mini 4K Instruct · Models · The Open-Source AI Stack
sources.snippet: Microsoft's first small-model release demonstrating that 3.8B parameters with heavy data filtering and synthetic data could reach MMLU 70%, matching much larger 2023-era models. A 128K-context variant shipped alongside via LongRoPE.
